title: New branch in Jakarta in order to establish a local presence
content: # Uhlmann Pac-Systeme has opened a new branch in Jakarta in order to establish a local presence. Uhlmann Pac-Systeme GmbH, the world‘s leading system provider for the packaging of pharmaceuticals in blisters, bottles, cartons and digital solutions, is further expanding its presence in Southeast Asia with a new branch in Indonesia; the largest and dynamically growing pharmaceutical market in this region. The family-owned company, headquartered in Germany (Laupheim), is launching its market presence with a strong trade fair appearance: At ALLPack Indonesia 2025, Uhlmann Pac-Systeme presented the blister line ECO 350 in live operation. At ALLPack, Uhlmann Pac-Systeme presented the blister line ECO 350, which was specially developed for maximum efficiency in pharmaceutical packaging. In addition to this machine, Uhlmann showcased the company's entire range of services at the trade fair: from innovative packaging machines and digital products to comprehensive service offerings. With local presence in Indonesia, Uhlmann Pac-Systeme is focusing on on-site service, short distances and fast support for customers in Indonesia.

title: Key figures & competencies of Uhlmann
content: Uhlmann company building with Uhlmann flags against a blue sky. Uhlmann Pac-Systeme is the world's leading system supplier for the packaging of pharmaceuticals in blisters, bottles and cartons. As a **leading global systems supplier** for the packaging of pharmaceutical products in blisters, bottles, and cartons, **Uhlmann Pac-Systeme GmbH & Co. KG** provides flexible integral solutions for international pharmaceutical companies, generics manufacturers, and contract packers. Under the motto "beyond packaging" the Uhlmann Group offers a broad range of machines, software products, services, and innovative solutions for the pharmaceutical, healthcare, consumer goods, food, and agricultural markets. Members of the Uhlmann Group are the companies Uhlmann Pac-Systeme in Laupheim, Koch Pac-Systeme in the Black Forest, Cremer Speciaalmachines in the Netherlands, Wonder Packing Machinery in China, Axito in Poland and Goldfuß Engineering in Balingen.
